2 · Adjective formation

Build the adjective in context

Complete each sentence with the adjective formed from the word in brackets. Change the spelling where necessary.

1
He is highly ___ and wants to lead the company one day. (ambition)
2
The two teams are extremely ___, even in friendly matches. (compete)
3
Her solution was both practical and highly ___. (imagine)
4
Our new colleague is so ___ that he never seems tired. (energy)
5
It was very ___ of her to share the prize with the whole team. (generosity)
6
I’m ___ about how the new system works. (curiosity)
7
She sounded genuinely ___ about the project. (enthusiasm)
8
The area has become popular with ___ business owners. (wealth)
3 · Mixed revision

Choose the adjective that fits the whole context

Use one adjective from the box. Each adjective is used once.

ambitious · competitive · energetic · generous · stubborn · thoughtful
1
Even during a casual online game, Max has to finish first and gets annoyed when he loses.
2
When a new colleague moved to the city, Rita spent her weekend helping them settle in and refused any payment.
3
The evidence was clear, but the manager still refused to change the plan.
4
After a full day at work, Leo still had enough energy to organise a team event.
5
Mila remembered that her colleague disliked crowded places and chose a quiet café for the meeting.
6
Anton has a clear long-term goal: he wants to build an international company.
4 · Your answers

Use the language actively

Write two or three complete sentences for each question. Your teacher will check these answers.

1 · Personal. Which two adjectives from this homework describe you best at work? Give evidence.
Try to use one adjective with a suffix.
2 · Opinion. Can being competitive make someone more successful, or does it usually create problems?
Useful language: on the one hand · however · it depends on
3 · Listening reflection. Which two lines from the recording were the most difficult to understand? What made them difficult?
Think about speed, linking and unfamiliar phrases.
